# OLS

```{r}
set.seed(47)
x <- seq(0, 20, by = 0.25)
y_true <- 3 * x + 10
y_noisy <- y_true + rnorm(length(x), 0 , 6)

ols_df <- data.frame(x, y_noisy)

ols_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y_noisy)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Simulated Data", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
ols_fit <- lm(y_noisy ~ x, data = ols_df)
b0 <- ols_fit$coefficients[1]
b1 <- ols_fit$coefficients[2]

ols_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y_noisy)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = b0 + b1 * x), color = "#74C8C0") +
  labs(title = "Simulated Data with Linear Fit", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# pick 5 points to highlight
residual_points <- ols_df[c(6, 21, 40, 55, 60, 74), ]

ols_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y_noisy)) +
  geom_segment(data = residual_points, aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y_noisy, yend = b0 + b1 * x),
    color = "#D6191B", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = residual_points, color = "#D6191B") +
  geom_line(aes(x = x, y = b0 + b1 * x), color = "#74C8C0") +
  labs(title = "Simulated Data with Linear Fit", x = "x", y = "y") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# create grid
b0_seq <- seq(b0 - 20, b0 + 20, length.out = 80)
b1_seq <- seq(b1 - 3,  b1 + 3,  length.out = 80)

# compute sse across grid
sse_matrix <- outer(b0_seq, b1_seq, FUN = function(b0, b1) {
  sapply(seq_along(b0), function(i) {
    residuals <- y_noisy - (b0[i] + b1[i] * x)
    sum(residuals^2)
  })
})

# plot
plot_ly() |>
  add_surface(
    x = b1_seq,
    y = b0_seq,
    z = sse_matrix,
    colorscale = list(c(0, "#2166AC"), c(0.25, "#74C8C0"), c(0.5, "#FFE81A"), c(0.75, "#F98E2B"), c(1, "#D6191B")),
    colorbar = list(title = "SSE"),
    contours = list(
      z = list(
        show      = TRUE,
        start     = 0,
        end       = max(sse_matrix),
        size      = 10000,
        color     = "white",
        width     = 2,
        highlight = FALSE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  add_markers(
    x = b1,
    y = b0,
    z = sum(residuals(ols_fit)^2),
    marker = list(color = "red", size = 6, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "OLS minimum"
  ) |>
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "β₁"),
      yaxis = list(title = "β₀"),
      zaxis = list(title = "SSE"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.5, y = -1.8, z = 0.8))
    ),
    title = list(text = "SSE solution space", x = 0.05)
  )
```



# double-sigmoidal data

```{r}
# f_base
f0 <- function(x, B1, M1, B2, L) {
  1 / ((1 + exp(-B1 * (x - M1))) * (1 + exp(B2 * (x - (M1 + L)))))
}

# piecewise double sigmoid
f2_new <- function(x, A2, Ka, B1, M1, B2, L, const, argument, h0) {
  f0_vals <- f0(x, B1, M1, B2, L)
  H <- fBasics::Heaviside(x - argument)  # Vectorized Heaviside function

  part1 <- H * (f0_vals * ((Ka - A2 * Ka) / const) + A2 * Ka)
  part2 <- (1 - H) * (f0_vals * ((Ka - h0) / const) + h0)

  return(part1 + part2)
}

# generate data
generate_piecewise_data <- function(x_vals = seq(0, 300, by = 20), reps = 5, dispersion = 100,
    B1 = 0.04, B2 = 0.03, M1 = 110, L = 130, h1 = 480, h2 = 240, h0 = 0) {
  A2 <- h2 / h1
  Ka <- h1

  set.seed(101)
  
  # find x-value corresponding to max of f0 (which is t*)
  x_dense <- seq(min(x_vals), max(x_vals), length.out = 1000)
  f0_vals <- f0(x_dense, B1, M1, B2, L)
  argument <- x_dense[which.max(f0_vals)]

  # const = f0
  const <- f0(argument, B1, M1, B2, L) # argument because max(f0) is at t*

  # add reps to x and y
  x_repeated <- rep(x_vals, each = reps)
  y_true <- f2_new(x_repeated, A2, Ka, B1, M1, B2, L, const, argument, h0)
  y_noisy <- rnorm(length(y_true), mean = y_true, sd = dispersion)

  # make df
  df <- data.frame(
    time = x_repeated,
    intensity = y_noisy
  )
  
  # plot
  plot <- df|>
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = intensity)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = argument), color = "red")
  
  return(df)
}

dub_sig_data <- generate_piecewise_data()

```

```{r}
library(sicegar)

# normalize the data first (sicegar requirement)
normalized_data <- normalizeData(
  dataInput = dub_sig_data,
  dataInputName = "dub_sig_data"
)

# fit the double sigmoidal model
double_sig_fit <- doublesigmoidalFitFunction_h0(
  dataInput = normalized_data,
  tryCounter = 500  # number of random starting points to try
)

```



```{r}
# double sigmoidal data
normalized_data$timeIntensityData |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = intensity)) + 
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y", title = "Simulated Nonlinear Data")
```

```{r}
# double sigmoidal data with fit
# generate fitted curve from parameters
fitted_curve <- sicegar::doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
  x         = seq(0, 300, by = 1),
  finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = double_sig_fit$finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio_Estimate,
  maximum                      = double_sig_fit$maximum_Estimate,
  slope1Param                  = double_sig_fit$slope1Param_Estimate,
  midPoint1Param               = double_sig_fit$midPoint1Param_Estimate,
  slope2Param                  = double_sig_fit$slope2Param_Estimate,
  midPointDistanceParam        = double_sig_fit$midPointDistanceParam_Estimate,
  h0                           = double_sig_fit$h0_Estimate)

fitted_df <- data.frame(time = seq(0, 300, by = 1), intensity = fitted_curve)

dub_sig_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = intensity)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = fitted_df, aes(x = time, y = intensity), color = "#74C8C0", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y", title = "Double Sigmoidal Fit")
```


```{r}
# true parameter values from data generation
B1 <- 0.04; B2 <- 0.03; M1 <- 110; L <- 130
h1 <- 480;  h2 <- 240;  h0 <- 0
Ka <- h1
A2 <- h2 / h1

fitted_curve_true <- doublesigmoidalFitFormula_h0(
  x                            = seq(0, 300, by = 1),
  finalAsymptoteIntensityRatio = A2,
  maximum                      = Ka,
  slope1Param                  = B1,
  midPoint1Param               = M1,
  slope2Param                  = B2,
  midPointDistanceParam        = L,
  h0                           = h0
)

fitted_df_true <- data.frame(time = seq(0, 300, by = 1), intensity = fitted_curve_true)

dub_sig_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = intensity)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(data = fitted_df_true, aes(x = time, y = intensity), color = "#74C8C0", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "x", y = "y", title = "Double Sigmoidal Fit")
```

# LMA
```{r}
# true min from the fit
b0_min <- 7.719172
b1_min <- 3.271829

# starting point
b0_start <- -7
b1_start <- 1

# simulate lma path
n_steps <- 30
damping  <- 0.85  # controls how quickly it converges

b0_path <- numeric(n_steps)
b1_path <- numeric(n_steps)
b0_path[1] <- b0_start
b1_path[1] <- b1_start

for (i in 2:n_steps) {
  b0_path[i] <- b0_min + (b0_path[i-1] - b0_min) * damping
  b1_path[i] <- b1_min + (b1_path[i-1] - b1_min) * damping
}

# compute sse along the path
sse_path <- sapply(seq_along(b0_path), function(i) {
  residuals <- y_noisy - (b0_path[i] + b1_path[i] * x)
  sum(residuals^2)
})

# grid
b0_seq <- seq(b0_min - 20, b0_min + 20, length.out = 80)
b1_seq <- seq(b1_min - 3,  b1_min + 3,  length.out = 80)

sse_matrix <- outer(b0_seq, b1_seq, FUN = function(b0, b1) {
  sapply(seq_along(b0), function(i) {
    residuals <- y_noisy - (b0[i] + b1[i] * x)
    sum(residuals^2)
  })
})

# plot
plot_ly() |>
  add_surface(
    x = b1_seq,
    y = b0_seq,
    z = sse_matrix,
    colorscale = list(c(0, "#2166AC"), c(0.25, "#74C8C0"), c(0.5, "#FFE81A"), c(0.75, "#F98E2B"), c(1, "#D6191B")),
    colorbar = list(title = "SSE"),
    contours = list(
      z = list(
        show      = TRUE,
        start     = 0,
        end       = max(sse_matrix),
        size      = 10000,
        color     = "white",
        width     = 2,
        highlight = FALSE
      )
    ),
    opacity = 0.85
  ) |>
  add_paths(
    x = b1_path,
    y = b0_path,
    z = sse_path + 200,   # slight offset so path sits above surface
    line = list(color = "violet", width = 5),
    name = "LM path"
  ) |>
  add_markers(
    x = b1_path[1],
    y = b0_path[1],
    z = sse_path[1] + 200,
    marker = list(color = "white", size = 7, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "Start"
  ) |>
  add_markers(
    x = b1_min,
    y = b0_min,
    z = min(sse_path) + 200,
    marker = list(color = "red", size = 7, symbol = "circle"),
    name = "Minimum"
  ) |>
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "β₁"),
      yaxis = list(title = "β₀"),
      zaxis = list(title = "SSE"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.5, y = -1.8, z = 0.8))
    ),
    title = list(text = "LMA Optimisation Path", x = 0.05)
  )
```


# rastrigin

```{r}
# --- Rastrigin function ---
rastrigin <- function(x, y, A = 10) {
  A * 2 + (x^2 - A * cos(2 * pi * x)) + (y^2 - A * cos(2 * pi * y))
}

# --- Grid ---
x_seq <- seq(-5.12, 5.12, length.out = 200)
y_seq <- seq(-5.12, 5.12, length.out = 200)

z_matrix <- outer(x_seq, y_seq, FUN = rastrigin)

# --- Plot ---
plot_ly() |>
  add_surface(
    x = x_seq,
    y = y_seq,
    z = z_matrix,
    colorscale = list(
      c(0, "#2166AC"), c(0.25, "#74C8C0"),
      c(0.5, "#FFE81A"), c(0.75, "#F98E2B"),
      c(1, "#D6191B")
    ),
    colorbar = list(title = "f(x, y)"),
    contours = list(
      z = list(
        show      = TRUE,
        start     = 0,
        end       = max(z_matrix),
        size      = 10,
        color     = "white",
        width     = 1,
        highlight = FALSE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "x"),
      yaxis = list(title = "y"),
      zaxis = list(title = "f(x, y)"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.5, y = -1.8, z = 1.2))
    ),
    title = list(text = "Rastrigin function", x = 0.05)
  )
```



# narrow canyon

```{r}
library(plotly)

# ============================================================
# 3D narrow canyon surface
# ============================================================

x <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 200)
y <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 200)

canyon_z <- function(x, y) {
  depth  <- 3
  width  <- 0.15
  -depth * exp(-x^2 / (2 * width^2))
}

z <- outer(x, y, canyon_z)

custom_colorscale <- list(
  c(0, "#2166AC"), c(0.25, "#74C8C0"),
  c(0.5, "#FFE81A"), c(0.75, "#F98E2B"), c(1, "#8B3A00"))

# ============================================================
# PLOT 1: surface only
# ============================================================
plot1 <- plot_ly(
  x = x, y = y, z = z,
  type       = "surface",
  colorscale = custom_colorscale,
  showscale  = FALSE
) |>
  layout(
    title = "Narrow Canyon",
    scene = list(
      xaxis  = list(title = "x"),
      yaxis  = list(title = "y"),
      zaxis  = list(title = "z"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.8, y = 1.8, z = 1.2))
    )
  )

plot1
```


with grid...

```{r}
# ============================================================
# PLOT 2: surface + 25 red dots in a 5x5 grid
# ============================================================

grid_x <- seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 5)
grid_y <- seq(-2.5, 2.5, length.out = 5)
grid   <- expand.grid(x = grid_x, y = grid_y)
grid$z <- canyon_z(grid$x, grid$y)

plot2 <- plot_ly(
  x = x, y = y, z = z,
  type       = "surface",
  colorscale = custom_colorscale,
  showscale  = FALSE,
  opacity    = 0.9
) |>
  add_trace(
    data   = grid,
    x      = ~y,
    y      = ~x,
    z      = ~z,
    type   = "scatter3d",
    mode   = "markers",
    marker = list(
      color  = "red",
      size   = 6,
      symbol = "circle"
    ),
    name = "grid points"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Narrow Canyon — Grid Points",
    scene = list(
      xaxis  = list(title = "x"),
      yaxis  = list(title = "y"),
      zaxis  = list(title = "z"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.8, y = 1.8, z = 1.2))
    )
  )

plot2
```
